# scripts/ops/Invoke-AvdSandboxBatch.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs one group of an approved sandbox batch: opens the spend run, deploys at the pinned commit, runs each item's test, keeps what must survive, tears down, and closes the spend run with teardown evidence (docs/sandbox-runs.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-BatchId` | string | yes, in the Id set |  |  |
| `-BatchPath` | string | yes, in the Path set |  |  |
| `-ApprovalPath` | string | no |  | Where the approval is read from. Default: approval.json next to batch.json. An unattended runner should read it from a place its own identity can't write (docs/sandbox-runs.md). |
| `-Group` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-MonthlyCap` | double | no | `$(if ($env:SPEND_MONTHLY_CAP) { [double]$env:SPEND_MONTHLY_CAP } else { 0 })` |  |
| `-RunCap` | double | no | `$(if ($env:SPEND_RUN_CAP) { [double]$env:SPEND_RUN_CAP } else { 0 })` |  |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
| `-RecordsPath` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Local` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-WorkRoot` | string | no |  | Where sources are checked out. Default: ~/avd-batch-src. |
| `-CloneBase` | string | no | `'https://github.com'` |  |
| `-RequireUnattended` | switch | no |  | A CI runner: refuse a group with any step that needs a person. |
| `-Resume` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-TeardownOnly` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-ContinueAfterStop` | switch | no |  | Start this group although an earlier group stopped the batch, once you have dealt with why. |
| `-SkipHealth` | switch | no |  | Skip the read-only health check (Test-AvdSandboxHealth.ps1) a new group starts with. |
| `-NoDeadlineTeardown` | switch | no |  | Run without the deadline teardown (decision 0021): a group whose shell dies keeps billing until someone tears it down. Needed with -Local, or a run store set up with -NoDeadlineTeardown. |
| `-PrivateRepo` | string | no | `$env:AVD_PRIVATE_REPO` | Recorded groups: the private companion repo the run recorder copies the run to after the close. Empty: the run stays in the run store only, and can be copied later. |
